component.name: WE Manager
component.summary: Play Wallpaper Engine wallpapers on the Linux desktop

description.p: WE Manager browses the Steam Workshop of Wallpaper Engine, keeps a library of your wallpapers with folders, tags and playlists, and plays them on your desktop with linux-wallpaperengine, which comes with it.
Scene, video and web wallpapers run per screen on KDE Plasma, wlroots compositors and X11. Wallpaper Engine has to be in your Steam library for its assets and the Workshop.
